'''Zrani''' was a [[Wistie/Legends|Wistie]], one of the glowing fairy-folk of the forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. She was captured by the [[Dulok/Legends|Dulok]] [[Agluk]], put in a lamp and used to light the way to him and the four adolescent [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] in a cave where the [[Griagh]] was hiding. [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa]] was able to communicate with her.

Later on, as the [[Griagh]] attacked, Zrani sacrificed her life to speed up and direct the weakened [[Sunstar/Legends|Sunstar]] tossed at the beast by [[Logray/Legends|Logray]]. At the victory ceremony after the battle, [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]] presented a flame which would forever burn in the memory of Zrani.
